title: Expectation under convolution of densities
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\psi$ and $\varphi$ be probability densities on $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. The expectation of $f$ under their convolution equals the uniform expectation over $z\in\mathbb F_2^n$ of $\varphi(z)$ times the expectation under $\psi$ of the function $y\mapsto f(y+z)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\psi$ and $\varphi$ are probability densities on $\mathbb F_2^n$
$f$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
